title: polystichum squarrosum
intro: Polystichum squarrosum, commonly known as the five-point fern, is a species of fern native to Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum squarrosum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities.
